description: This file contains code for generating C shim code for PyTorch operators, including functions to generate headers, definitions, and files for different dispatch keys. It handles argument conversion, versioning, and integration with the PyTorch build system, focusing on automation of C interface generation for operators with fallback support.

classes.name: ShimGenerator
classes.description: A data class for generating C shim code for operators, containing configuration and a callable method to generate code for each NativeFunction.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],list[str],list[str],list[str]] convert_arg_type_and_name( typ: Type, name: str, is_write: bool = False, )
methods.description: Converts argument types and names into C-compatible types, callsite expressions, and aten types, handling optional and list types.

methods.name: list[str] zip_type_and_name(types: list[str], names: list[str])
methods.description: Pairs types and names into combined string declarations.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],list[str]] gen_arguments( flat_arguments: Sequence[Argument], skipped_args: set[str] )
methods.description: Generates argument declarations and callsite expressions from function arguments, considering skipped args.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],list[str]] gen_returns(schema: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Generates return value declarations and callsite assignments based on function schema.

methods.name: tuple[str,str] gen_declaration_and_definition( schema: FunctionSchema, device: str, backend_call: str, version_info: dict[str, list[str]], )
methods.description: Generates C function declaration and definition strings for a given function schema, including versioned and out variants.

methods.name: CppSignature gen_static_dispatch_backend_call_signature( sig: CppSignature | DispatcherSignature, f: NativeFunction, )
methods.description: Creates a CppSignature object for the static dispatch backend call based on function schema.

methods.name: str gen_static_dispatch_backend_call( f: NativeFunction, backend_index: BackendIndex | None = None, )
methods.description: Generates the string for calling the backend implementation, considering symint and dispatch key.

methods.name: BackendIndex|None get_backend_index_for_aoti( func: NativeFunction, func_group_mapping: dict[OperatorName, NativeFunctionsGroup], dispatch_key: DispatchKey | None, backend_indices: dict[DispatchKey, BackendIndex], extend_aoti_c_shim: bool, )
methods.description: Determines the appropriate BackendIndex for a given function and dispatch key, considering available kernels.

methods.name: str|None get_header_for_aoti( func: NativeFunction, func_group_mapping: dict[OperatorName, NativeFunctionsGroup], dispatch_key: DispatchKey | None, backend_indices: dict[DispatchKey, BackendIndex], extend_aoti_c_shim: bool, )
methods.description: Returns the include header string for a given operator based on dispatch key and backend index.

methods.name: str get_fallback_op_name(func: NativeFunction)
methods.description: Returns the fallback operator name string based on the NativeFunction.

methods.name: str|None gen_c_shim( func: NativeFunction, version_info: dict[str, list[str]], func_group_mapping: dict[OperatorName, NativeFunctionsGroup], dispatch_key: DispatchKey | None, backend_indices: dict[DispatchKey, BackendIndex], header: bool, extend_aoti_c_shim: bool, )
methods.description: Generates either header or implementation code for a specific operator, based on dispatch key, version info, and configuration.

methods.name: str gen_aoti_c_shim( native_functions: Sequence[NativeFunction], inductor_fallback_ops: dict[str, dict[str, list[str]]], func_group_mapping: dict[OperatorName, NativeFunctionsGroup], dispatch_key: DispatchKey | None, backend_indices: dict[DispatchKey, BackendIndex], header: bool, extend_aoti_c_shim: bool, includes: str = "", )
methods.description: Generates the full C shim code (header or source) for all native functions, managing includes and formatting.

methods.name: None gen_aoti_c_shim_files( aoti_fm: FileManager, aoti_backends: set[DispatchKey | None], native_functions: Sequence[NativeFunction], backend_indices: dict[DispatchKey, BackendIndex], structured_native_functions: Sequence[NativeFunctionsGroup], extra_cuda_headers: str, extend_aoti_c_shim: bool, update_aoti_c_shim: bool, )
methods.description: Creates or updates the C shim header and source files for each dispatch key, with ABI compatibility checks and integration with build system.
